## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive. Strong sector breadth but mixed leadership and multiple large-cap trend divergences (AAPL BELOW TREND, NVDA ABOVE TREND, GOOGL RECOVERY) justify caution; Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Healthcare lead: MRK (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND; Materials: FCX (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +21.83%) ABOVE TREND; Financials: C (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +15.93%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Consumer Discretionary: TSLA (1W: -3.65% | 1M: +8.69%) CORRECTION and several names showing CORRECTIONs; Consumer Staples: PEP (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND; Technology: AAPL (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -1.53%) BELOW TREND despite NVDA strength.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: MRK (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +21.83%) ABOVE TREND; NKE (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -4.55%) RECOVERY; PM (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +3.88%) ABOVE TREND; C (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +15.93%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: F (1W: -1.53% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION; UPS (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +4.75%) CORRECTION; WMT (1W: -1.75% | 1M: +3.19%) CORRECTION; MET (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +4.98%) CORRECTION; MDT (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in selective consumer and healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Top 1W movers: MRK (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +21.83%) ABOVE TREND, NKE (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -4.55%) RECOVERY — watch RECOVERY names (NKE, TMUS) for follow-through vs. trend fatigue.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
NVDA (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND leading; MSFT (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +0.32%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -1.53%) BELOW TREND — Technology breadth: 19/19 positive, but internal dispersion (growth names mixed).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials broadly strong: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +6.53%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND — Financials breadth: 20/20 positive; style: Value/Cyclical favored.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
MRK (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND anchor the group; LLY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: -2.45%) RECOVERY and MDT (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND indicate dispersion — Healthcare breadth: 15/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials and Materials exposure (JPM, C, FCX) while reducing exposure to names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (AAPL, TSLA, MDT); monitor NVDA and MRK for continuation given above-trend momentum.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +21.83%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: MDT (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -1.53%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -1.53% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Financials (20/20 positive), Materials (7/7 positive), Energy (8/8 positive) — watch for cyclical follow-through.  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (12/12 positive on 1W but many CORRECTIONs) and Consumer Staples (11/11 positive but pockets BELOW TREND) — watch for rotational risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA resistance test and continuation as ABOVE TREND signal; AAPL support breaches would confirm BELOW TREND pressure; JPM holding recent breakout would confirm Financials momentum; MDT failure to reclaim 1M trend confirms downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (+85): Intel sells $5B stake to Nvidia — sentiment very bullish; price not a top mover this week, watch for confirming flow.  
TMUS (+50): T-Mobile upgrade — TMUS (1W: +3.30% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, sentiment confirming 1W momentum.  
C (+50): Citigroup relief/turnaround headlines — C (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +15.93%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
F (-85): Ford $19.5B EV hit headline — F (1W: -1.53% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION, sentiment confirms distribution risk.  
AMZN (-45): Drone rollout shelved — AMZN (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging; watch for follow-through.  
CVX (-45): Tengiz output hit chatter — CVX (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +1.11%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging; monitor operational headlines.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt. NVDA (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: broad sector breadth masks internal divergences (AAPL BELOW TREND, multiple CORRECTIONs) and bullish news (INTC +85) not yet fully reflected in price.
